title: Prague Dependency Treebank -- Consolidated 2.0: Enriching a Complex Annotation Scheme
abstract: arXiv:2606.24324v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The Prague Dependency Treebank framework is unique in its attempt to systematically include and link different layers of language, including a meaning representation with several types of inter-sentential phenomena, especially coreference and discourse relations. We present its second consolidated version (PDT-C 2.0), which concludes almost 30-years long project of sustained development of the resource to a uniformly and coherently annotated, genre-diversified, almost 4 million token language resource of Czech language, with accompanying fully compatible lexicons. In addition to continuous linguistic research, the richly linguistically annotated corpus is also widely used in international comparisons of the development of traditional and novel NLP tools as well as in conversions into other formalisms. The corpus and the trained parsers are available under the CC BY-NC-SA licence.

translated_title: 布拉格依存树库——整合版2.0：丰富复杂的标注体系
translated_abstract: 布拉格依存树库框架的独特之处在于其尝试系统地包含并关联语言的不同层次，包括带有多种句际现象（尤其是共指和篇章关系）的意义表示。我们呈现其第二个整合版本（PDT-C 2.0），这标志着近30年持续开发该资源项目的完成，使之成为一个标注统一连贯、体裁多样、近400万词符的捷克语语言资源，并配有完全兼容的词库。除了持续的语言学研究之外，这一语言标注丰富的语料库还被广泛用于传统与新型NLP工具发展的国际比较，以及向其他形式体系的转换。该语料库和训练好的解析器可在CC BY-NC-SA许可下获取。
tldr: 布拉格依存树库整合版2.0（PDT-C 2.0）历时近30年开发完成，是一个近400万词符、标注统一连贯、体裁多样并系统整合了共指和篇章关系等多层次语言标注的捷克语资源。
en_tdlr: PDT-C 2.0, the second consolidated version of the Prague Dependency Treebank concluding nearly 30 years of development, is a uniformly annotated, genre-diverse, almost 4 million token Czech resource that uniquely integrates multiple linguistic layers including coreference and discourse relations.
